title: Cheetah
desc: Jamal, a gangster, kills Amar's family. To everyone's surprise, the latter survives, wakes from a coma and seeks revenge.

title: Abhagini
desc: Abhagini is tortured by her stepmother all her life, but she decides to make a new start after leaving the city. Initially, the new family she is living with dislikes her, but she soon wins them over.

title: Pratham Dekha
desc: Two struggling singers, who hope to make their way to the top, fall in love and fight to stay together amidst various societal barriers.

title: Baba Taraknath
desc: Amar, an explorer conducting research on snake venom, loves Sudha and the two get married. However, their marital bliss is dampened when an astrologer predicts Amar's death.

title: Guru Dakshina
desc: Jayant, an aspiring singer, finds his way to the city in order to make it big. Soon, he garners accolades for his performances and eventually falls in love with the daughter of a ruthless businessman.
